description: Create a link to the AkulaCyber store cart with the chosen products and quantities already in it, at live prices in UAH, for the user to open, review and check out on the site. Use it when the user is ready to buy or wants several products in one cart; identify products with akulacyber_search_products first, and for a single piece of one product the cart_url of akulacyber_get_product is enough. Nothing is ordered, reserved or paid here. Repeated products are added together (at most 99 each); out-of-stock products are left out and listed in unavailable; an unknown product, or none in stock, returns an error.

product.description: A product slug from search results (gl-rm1), a model or part number (GL-RM1) or a GTIN.

lang.description: Language of the texts and page URLs in the answer: uk (Ukrainian, the default), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language the user writes in.

name: akulacyber_create_cart_link
title: Create an AkulaCyber cart link
